data.name: Vishal Patwardhan
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Vishal Patwardhan has made a big mark in cricket. With 83 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 95, with an average of 28.37 and a quick strike rate of 139.40. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 46 sixes and 152 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 121.3 overs, taking 63 wickets at an economy rate of 7.84. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
